items.title: Add original intent snapshot and milestone ledger commands
items.context: Implement original_intent_snapshot_set/get and milestone_ledger_set/add/get as PLAN-oriented process artifacts. The minimum Intent MVP payload is sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim. Milestone ledger should be optional and triggered by multi-deliverable structural or semantic signals.

items.title: Add ProofStory contract storage commands
items.context: Implement proofstory_contract_set/get for the MVP contract, including internal progressive intent hardening classification in the stored contract without adding a standalone hardening command.

items.title: Add dry-run intent coverage and ProofStory gate diagnostics
items.context: Implement intent_coverage_check --dryRun and proofstory_gate_check --dryRun. They should report missing artifacts, selected hardening level, trigger reasons, and would-block diagnostics without enforcing DEV admission.

items.title: Validate commands, process-fact registration, and docs alignment
items.context: Add focused tests and process-fact coverage for the new commands/artifacts. Run build and targeted validation, but do not enable global enforce behavior.
